answer: Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. The hollow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta.
